answer: One concrete mechanism: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The onyx of work and the nadir of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a mesa to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
